Hi Jamie / Alex  great speaking with you both earlier, appreciated the time. Below is a short post-call recap + immediate next steps we can take on the compliance items you flagged.

Recap (high level)
- Use case: MedConnect will evaluate Redwood for chat/triage workflows that may process PHI; HIPAA is a hard requirement for any production handling of PHI.
- Data flow: customer messages originate in MedConnect app, routed to Redwood hosted inference; you asked about which third parties see any metadata or content.

Immediate answers
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II. I will attach the most recent report (redacted) to this thread.
- Subprocessors: primary infra is AWS (us-west-2) for hosted; we also use GCP for model training/experimental workloads and a third-party analytics provider (Amplitude) for telemetry. I'll share the full subprocessor matrix PDF.
- HIPAA / BAA: Our hosted (shared) offering requires a Private/Dedicated deployment and a signed BAA for PHI production workloads. We can discuss Dedicated or Private deployments and the associated procurement path.
- GDPR: we support data deletion and customer-controlled retention settings; we can discuss data residency for EU customers.

Attachments I'll send by EOD: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, redwood_subprocessors_2026-05.pdf

Proposed next steps
1) I'll upload the SOC 2 report and subprocessor matrix to a secure SharePoint link (or send via your security portal) by EOD 6/3.
2) If you want, fill out the attached questionnaire and we can schedule a 30-min security deep-dive next week (propose Tue 6/9 or Wed 6/10).
3) For HIPAA production: schedule a Dedicated/Private scoping call with our solutions team  Rishi is copied and can run next steps.

Let me know if that works and which time you'd prefer for the deep-dive.

Best,

Adding a couple of technical clarifications from the infra side:
- BAA/PHI: our standard hosted (multi-tenant) service does not have a BAA option. To support PHI under HIPAA we require either Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool in our managed offering) or Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) so that network and data controls meet BAA requirements.
- Encryption: all customer data in transit is TLS 1.2+, at rest storage is encrypted with customer-managed KMS for Private deployments and our managed KMS for hosted. KV cache and model context are isolated per-tenant in Dedicated/Private.
- Subprocessor detail: AWS (EC2/EBS/S3), GCP (for ML training), Cloudflare (CDN), Amplitude (telemetry)  full matrix will show data categories each vendor can access.

Happy to join the deep-dive and go through the matrix row-by-row.

 Rishi
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
